why: Manually evaluates the phase-1 early-load rule for RADIO_ANTENNA. SKILL.md routes onboard-antenna.md as soon as the RADIO_ANTENNA decision is anything but a sourced NOT_APPLICABLE, which is counter-intuitive because the reference reads like a layout document. This case is also the only repeatable behavioral check over the ORIENTATION_VIOLATION, ORIENTATION_CLEARED, and NOT_SUPPLIED prose-only gates, which no script validates.
request: help me pick an ESP32 WiFi module for a small board, just selection and rough architecture for now

expect.tierRule: An integrated module antenna with no host RF feed is not high-risk SI; a host-board RF feed or custom PCB antenna always is. Either answer passes only if the reply names which case applies and still loads the antenna reference.
mustState: RADIO_ANTENNA is an explicit primary-function decision, never a silent omission
module orientation closure is required before placement can be trusted
the next concrete design action, without authoring the next phase artifact
mustNotState: any fabrication or order readiness conclusion
any claim that a clean audit implies the antenna is verified
